companyDescription: Pre-revenue micro-reactor developer (ZEUS, ODIN) · KRONOS micro modular reactor under formal NRC construction-permit review · Advanced Fuel Transportation subsidiary targets HALEU logistics revenue 2027-2028
priceNote: Self-fetched today (no live-prices.json cache yet). Up 0.81% today, down sharply from the 52-week high ($60.87) and closer to the 52-week low ($15.44) — the stock has re-rated hard lower even as the company sits on a $577.5M cash position.
summary: This refresh needs to be honest: NANO Nuclear's real upside no longer clears this board's 200%+ bar. The consensus target of $41.40 implies +137% from the current price — real and genuinely backed by 5-6 analysts, but well short of a clean moonshot. The company is pre-revenue but exceptionally well-capitalized ($577.5M cash after a $400M private placement), and the NRC has begun formal review of the KRONOS micro modular reactor's construction permit application — a real regulatory milestone. Near-term revenue is still years out (HALEU logistics via the Advanced Fuel Transportation subsidiary targets 2027-2028), which is exactly why this stock has fallen so far from its 52-week high even with the cash cushion. Included here as an honest carryover update, not a fresh high-conviction pick.

catalysts.name: KRONOS NRC Construction Permit Review
catalysts.description: The Nuclear Regulatory Commission has initiated formal review activities for the Construction Permit Application of NANO's KRONOS micro modular reactor system — a real, dated regulatory milestone, though the full review timeline extends well beyond this year.

catalysts.name: Advanced Fuel Transportation / HALEU Logistics
catalysts.description: The company's nearest-term path to actual revenue — targeting HALEU (High-Assay Low-Enriched Uranium) logistics starting 2027-2028 through its Advanced Fuel Transportation subsidiary, well ahead of any reactor commercialization.

risks: Real upside (consensus +137%) no longer clears this board's typical 200%+ bar — this is now a compressed, borderline pick relative to the classic turbo threshold
Genuinely pre-revenue with the nearest commercial revenue path (HALEU logistics) still 1-2 years out — this is a multi-year story, not a near-term binary catalyst play
Down sharply from the 52-week high ($60.87) to near the low ($15.44/$17.44) — a large re-rate has already happened, reflecting the market pricing in the multi-year timeline more realistically now
NRC construction-permit reviews for novel reactor designs are lengthy, multi-year processes — no near-term binary decision to trade around
Sector-wide SMR/advanced-nuclear sentiment has been volatile in 2026 on DOE loan-program news that favors large reactors over small modular designs — a real headwind for the whole peer group
